text: At birth: BCG and OPV 0. At 6 weeks: Pentavalent 1, OPV 1, PCV 1, Rotavirus 1. At 10 weeks: Pentavalent 2, OPV 2, PCV 2, Rotavirus 2. At 14 weeks: Pentavalent 3, OPV 3, PCV 3, IPV.

section: Nine and Eighteen Month Childhood Vaccines
text: At 9 months: Measles-Rubella 1, Yellow Fever, and Malaria Dose 1 (in approved regions). At 18 months: Meningitis A (MenA) and Measles-Rubella 2.
